data.raw_text:
Students and various progressive groups stage a protest against massive government corruption on Friday, Nov. 21 to mark National Day of Walkout Against Corruption.

The protest was joined by students from University of Santo Tomas, Far Eastern University, De La Salle University, University of the East, UP Manila, UP Diliman, Mapua University, Lyceum of the Philippines University, Philippine University, Eulogio "Amang" Rodriguez Institute of Science and Technology, National Teachers College, Polytechnic University of the Philippines, and Centro Escolar University.

(Photos by Ethan Joshua Nikholai F. Guisama/ The Varsitarian)

data.raw_text:
Sa pangunguna ng MMDA at pakikipagtulungan ng TUPAD beneficiaries, umabot sa 100 sako ng basura ang nakolekta mula sa Buli River na sakop ng Barangay Sucat at Barangay Buli, Muntinlupa City kamakailan. 

Isang malaking hakbang tungo sa mas malinis at ligtas na komunidad! Bahagi ang operasyon ng patuloy na pagsisikap ng MMDA na panatilihing malinis ang daluyang tubig at maiwasan ang baha sa mga komunidad sa Metro Manila. 

Sama-sama nating panatilihin ang kalinisan ng ating kapaligiran!
#mmda #mmdaatyourservice

data.english_translation: Led by MMDA and the cooperation of TUPAD pereneficiaries, up to 100 sacks of garbage have been collected from the Buli River covered by Barangaya Sucat and Barangay Buli, recently Takanland City. A major step toward cleaner and safer communities! Part of the operation of MMDA’s continued efforts to keep the aqueduct clean and to avoid the floods in Metro communities. We are able to maintain our environment! #mmdamyceervier’s environment!

Hundreds of students from various universities in Manila walked out of their campuses and gathered in Mendiola to stage a protest against corruption on Friday, November 21.

The protesters stood loosely across the area while police officers kept close watch. Traffic in the vicinity became congested as the rallyists occupied both lanes of the street. 

📷: Mark Balmores | MB
